output.summary: A lily native to China, Japan, Korea and the Russian Far East. It has showy orange-and-black, scentless flowers and produces small bulbs in its leaf joints that can grow into cloned plants. In Asia, its bulbs are cultivated and gathered from the wild for food; in Taiwan, the flowers are also eaten.
output.edibilityNote: Bulbs are cultivated and wild-foraged for food in Asia; both flowers and bulbs are eaten in Taiwan.
